# Pesher Habakkuk Column 9 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QpHab (Cave 1), Col. 9 | **Condition:** Well preserved

---

**9:1** "Moreover, wealth betrays a-haughty man,

**9:2** and-he will-not abide — he-who has-widened

**9:3** his-throat like-Sheol, and-like death

**9:4** he-cannot be-satisfied. He-gathers to-himself

**9:5** all the-nations and-collects to-himself all the-peoples" (Hab 2:5).

**9:6** Its pesher concerns the-Wicked-Priest, who

**9:7** was-called by-the-name-of truth at-the-beginning-of

**9:8** his-standing; but when-he-ruled over-Israel,

**9:9** his-heart was-lifted-up and-he-forsook God and-betrayed

**9:10** the-statutes for-the-sake-of wealth.

**9:11** He-plundered and-gathered the-wealth-of the-men-of violence

**9:12** who-had-rebelled against-God, and-he-took the-wealth-of

**9:13** peoples, to-add to-himself guilty iniquity.

**9:14** And-abominable ways he-practiced

**9:15** in-every sort-of unclean defilement.

**9:16** "'Woe to-him-who heaps-up what-is-not-his-own!

**9:17** How-long? And-who-loads himself-with pledges!' (Hab 2:6b)

---
*EMET notes: Column 9 covers Hab 2:5-6. The pesher format alternates between quotations of Habakkuk and their sectarian interpretations (pesharim). Hyphenated forms reflect Hebrew construct chains and bound morphemes. Technical sectarian terms preserved: Teacher of Righteousness (Moreh ha-Tsedeq), Wicked Priest (ha-Kohen ha-Rasha'), Man of the Lie (Ish ha-Kazav), Kittim (identified with Romans), Spouter of the Lie (Mattif ha-Kazav). Lacunae marked with [...] represent genuine manuscript damage.*
